role: integrated scene concept and art-direction reference
reference: User-attached medieval chapel gameplay screenshot; camera and ground projection take precedence over previous building sheets

direction.camera: Elevated front-left three-quarter view, short front facade and long right side
direction.paving: Oblique diamond lattice on the same ground plane as the architecture; visible short stone side faces, no top-down square grid
direction.architecture: Grand late-medieval Gothic abbey, slender tall tower, deep dark windows, weathered limestone and slate; human scale approximately 1:6 to 1:8
direction.vegetation: Mixed mature broadleaf trees, birch, yew, low shrubs, ferns, brambles, grasses and sparse wildflowers in varied clumps
direction.terrain: Raised accessible terrace, visible retaining rock, continuous stair/ramp access and a higher wooded ridge
direction.light: Natural daylight from upper left; no player-centered spotlight or night filter

integration: Applied to the forest abbey at runtime: native abbey and six undergrowth species, diagonal world-anchored paving, shared stair/cliff collision and NPC approaches. Original concept retained as the composition reference.
